features.title: Bookings, clients, reminders and money in one app

calendar.title: Client booking calendar
calendar.text: Every booking for the day and the week on one screen. Free slots show up right away, and a new booking takes three taps.
calendar.p1: Free slots are counted for you
calendar.p3: A template for your work week

clients.title: Client list with visit history
clients.text: A card for every client: visits, average ticket, photos of your work and notes.

reminders.title: WhatsApp reminders for clients
reminders.text: The text with the name, time and service is ready, and you send it from your own number. Clients who haven’t booked in a while go on a “time to invite” list.
reminders.p1: WhatsApp, Telegram or copy the text

money.title: Income and expense tracking
money.text: Visits count as income on their own, and an expense takes a second to add. At the end of the month you see what’s left as net.
money.p1: Income by day, week and month

booking.title: Online booking through your own page
booking.text: Clients book themselves, even when you’re busy. They don’t need to install anything, and you decide whether to accept requests right away or confirm them by hand.

page.title: The client opens your page
page.text: Photos, work, services and prices at getseene.app/name, from Instagram, WhatsApp or Google Maps.

services.title: Picks services
services.text: Several at once if she likes; the total and time add up on their own.

time.title: Picks a day and time
time.text: Only the slots you opened in your schedule are shown.

done.title: Confirms her number, and she’s booked
done.text: A code by WhatsApp or Telegram, no sign-up. The booking lands in your calendar right away.

notebook.q: How is Seene better than a notebook and Instagram?
notebook.a: All your bookings, clients and money in one place. The app reminds clients about their visit and tells you who is due to book again.

install.q: Do my clients need to install anything?
install.a: No. Reminders arrive in their regular WhatsApp, and online booking opens from a link in the browser.

reminders.a: Seene drafts the text with the name, time and service. You send it from your own number and can change any word.

price.a: Calendar, client list and reminders are free. Pro, with “time to invite” and money tracking, costs less than one appointment a month. No commission.

platforms.q: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
platforms.a: Yes, the app will be on the App Store and Google Play. The online booking page opens on any phone.

data.q: Who can see my clients’ data?
data.a: Only you. We don’t sell data and we never message your clients. You can delete your whole account in settings.
